title: Create src/lib/feature/specGenerator.ts — prompt assembly and AI response parsing
description: Create a module that assembles the full spec generation prompt, calls the AI backend, collects streamed output, and parses the structured JSON response containing the feature spec and new tasks.
acceptanceCriteria: Correctly parses JSON envelope { spec: string, tasks: Task[] } from AI output
Handles JSON wrapped in markdown code fences
Throws a descriptive error with raw output logged if JSON parsing fails

steps.details: Create the file. Define: export type SpecContext = { prdContent: string; featureDescription: string; qa: { question: string; answer: string }[] }. Import AgentBackend, buildSpecPrompt from prompts.ts.

export async function generateSpec(context: SpecContext, backend: AgentBackend): Promise<{ specMarkdown: string; tasks: Omit<Task, 'id'>[] }> { const prompt = buildSpecPrompt(context.prdContent, context.featureDescription, context.qa); const proc = backend.spawn(prompt, {}); const output = await collectOutput(proc); return parseSpecResponse(output) }

async function collectOutput(proc: ChildProcess): Promise<string> { return new Promise((resolve, reject) => { let output = ''; proc.stdout?.on('data', d => output += d.toString()); proc.stderr?.on('data', d => output += d.toString()); proc.on('close', () => resolve(output)); proc.on('error', reject) }) }

function parseSpecResponse(output: string): { specMarkdown: string; tasks: Task[] } { // Strip markdown code fences const cleaned = output.replace(/```json\n?/g, '').replace(/```\n?/g, ''); const jsonMatch = cleaned.match(/\{[\s\S]+\}/); if (!jsonMatch) throw new Error('Could not parse AI response...'); const parsed = JSON.parse(jsonMatch[0]); return { specMarkdown: parsed.spec, tasks: parsed.tasks } }

technicalNotes: The AI response JSON may be surrounded by text before and after — use a regex to extract the first { ... } block
Log raw output to .agent/logs/LOG.md before throwing for debugging
